posts.title: Professional Updater
posts.description: It's been a lot of updates lately. And not of the cool kind with features you want. More like: update asap to not be at risk! You are probably already late! Ubuntu PHP Node JS Craft CMS Kirby CMS All kinds of plugins. Or even stuff like Twig. Also homelab patching of everything . The good parts Professionalizing all monitoring tools, and getting all projects up to date. Learning a lot about Ubuntu

posts.title: reMarkable inkbridge
posts.description: I was very inspired by this post from a few days ago, and decided to have a go at something along those lines for myself but for macOS and my Paper Pure. What is it? Inkbridge is a small terminal tool that turns the reMarkable into a pressure-sensitive drawing tablet for your Mac, over USB or Wi-Fi. posts.title: Doing the boring work
posts.description: Doing those CMS updates. Updating Ubuntu on the server. Upgrading your PHP version. Upgrading the database. Getting rid of deprecation notices. Making sure all backups are running as they should. No stuck queues, no stopped daemons or cron jobs. Deployments still running smoothly.
